summary: Size::Table left-pop performs size_table.pop_front() inside debug_assert_eq!, so disabling debug assertions skips the mutation. The stale size table can misdirect subsequent indexing and cause a panic. The fix executes the pop unconditionally and asserts only its result. The implementation reversal is exact and unique, but no detecting upstream test was established at this revision: the fix adds no tests, and inspection of existing vector regression and property tests did not establish coverage of the required table-backed left-pop and subsequent indexing. Leave this candidate blocked. Any future comparison must disable debug assertions consistently; no builds or tests were run.
